title: tc-file-import
description:
Drop a CSV, TSV or Excel file and see what was read: rows and columns found, the delimiter, the header row, a
preview with each column's type in words, problems in words, and Continue.

description.description: A quiet line under the heading – what the rows will become

headerRow.description: Whether the first row holds the column names. Changed by its checkbox unless a tc-header-row-change listener calls preventDefault()

accept.description: The file types the picker offers, as for an input's accept

previewRows.description: How many rows the preview shows

labels.description: Words the page can rename, merged over defaultFileImportLabels
